title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders 'Heavily Skewed' Towards PS5
summary: Sony reportedly dominating biggest game of the generation

Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 Pre-Orders 'Heavily Skewed' Towards PS5 Sony reportedly dominating biggest game of the generation by Sammy Barker 2 hours ago Share: Image: Push Square Sony is spending an obscene amount of money to make sure GTA 6 “feels” like an exclusive – and it’s working, apparently. A new report from The Verge (paywalled) digs into the larger dramas occurring at Xbox of late, including its massive layoffs and restructuring. (I wrote a little bit about how the platform feels like it’s being swallowed by Activision and Bethesda through here .) But there’s one interesting tidbit in the article that jumped out to me: “Sources at Xbox tell me that GTA 6 pre-orders are heavily skewed toward PS5, ringing yet more alarm bells about the platform.” This article has been written by Tom Warren, who’s remarkably well-connected with Microsoft, so I believe the reporting. It would be interesting to know just how skewed the pre-orders are, though. Obviously, Sony has a massive install base advantage over Microsoft anyway, with the PS5 approaching 100 million units sold compared to the Xbox Series X|S’ estimated ~35 million. Therefore you’d expect a difference of roughly 3:1 in the pre-orders, but I wonder if Sony’s marketing is skewing things even more heavily in the PS5’s favour. That would certainly be enough to set alarm bells ringing in Redmond. I wonder if we’ll ever get data on this. I’m sure Alinea will put out some predictions, but I can’t see Rockstar commenting on this. I expect PlayStation’s marketing alliance is going to get even more aggressive once GTA 6’s TV ads start airing closer to release, so I imagine you’re going to see those pre-orders continue to slide even more aggressively in Sony’s favour.
